text: Alright, so lets drop back down to the performance indicators in the bottom dock and when i click on fps i want to get a popover that gives me a readout of what is causing churn, this means we need instrumentation on everything. What is re-rendering, what is causing performance loss
resolution: Added a clickable FPS performance diagnostics surface to the editor bottom dock. The FPS readout now opens a churn popover that combines real host frame buckets, GPU/node pressure, host mutation flush telemetry, React region render probes, and hook/effect churn. Added runtime RenderProbe aggregation via React Profiler for editor regions and exposed existing host-flush telemetry through useTelemetry, while keeping polling to the mounted popover/dock rather than per-frame logs.
